pivotal_result: STEP 1, a double-blind trial in 1961 adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes: the mean change in body weight from baseline to week 68 was -14.9% in the semaglutide 2.4 mg once-weekly group compared with -2.4% with placebo, an estimated treatment difference of -12.4 percentage points (95% CI -13.4 to -11.5; P less than 0.001). Trial registration NCT03548935; paper DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2032183, published online 2021-02-10.
